baseline.name: PR522 rank-sector word (99 pivots, 80 gauges)
baseline.scope: proxy b: nine-stage one-owner hosting IP with banks, 120 ports; same proxy for every candidate

hypothesis: Random perturbations of the PR522 factory (pair matching per block and parity; Hamming packet-orientation seed) with exact kernel/gauge rescan beat the published factory.
verification_scope: Each candidate: factory rebuilt by PR522 construct_ranksector.py; retimed frames transferred by sequence matching (raw-frame fallback); gauge/kernel frozen selection or exact rational rescan (rescan reproduces 99 pivots on the baseline); profile and widths by gk_word; proxy price only. No full replay of any candidate.
do_not_repeat_scope: 1-4 random flips of the 14x2 pair-matching table around the PR522 spec; orientation-seed changes WITHOUT re-retiming (they lose the PR514 retimed frames and price ~1.2e-5 lower).
retry_when: Orientation-seed candidates are re-retimed (new frame descent) or the kernel rescan gains gauge re-selection; or a wider (non-local) matching search is used.
